concept_statement: A warm, high-trust 'Modern Clinical OS' aesthetic. Moving away from generic dark SaaS themes, this design uses a 'Clinical Bone & Indian Saffron' palette to blend clinical precision with approachability. It relies on tight-tracking Grotesk typography for authority, bento grids for dense data visualization, and an outcome-first layout that clearly demonstrates how AUDINEXA replaces messy spreadsheets for Indian audiology clinics. No 'waitlist' vibes—just pure, confident B2B software ready to run a clinic.

headings.rationale: Provides authority, precision, and modern corporate weight without looking generic. Use with tight tracking (tracking-tight) to feel like a high-end editorial tech brand.
headings.weights: Light (300) for subheaders, Bold (700) or ExtraBold (800) for H1/H2.

body.rationale: Sterile, highly legible, data-heavy clinical font. Perfect for medical dashboards, dense pricing tables, and FAQ.

labels.rationale: For technical micro-copy like 'GST-Ready', 'DPDPA', or live proof metrics.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Tactical Neumorphism' – solid flat backgrounds with a sharp 1px border (border-border/40) combined with a soft, diffuse ambient shadow (shadow-sm) for elevation. Avoid 'Apple Glassmorphism' to prevent clinical data from looking muddy or refracted.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate very subtle grain/noise on solid backgrounds to kill the 'digital flatness' and make it feel tactile and physical, like medical paper.
visual_enhancers.gradients: BANNED globally, except for the 'Tracing Beam' active state on the primary pricing card.

1_header.layout: Fixed top. Solid background (Clinical Bone). Left: AUDINEXA logo in Cabinet Grotesk. Center: Nav links (Features, Diagnostics, Pricing, FAQ). Right: Secondary CTA 'Sign in' (text link) + Primary CTA 'Start 30-day trial' (Solid Saffron pill button).

variant_A_outcome_focus.layout: Left-aligned 60/40 split. Left: Massive H1 (text-5xl md:text-6xl+). 'The Audiology Clinic OS Built for India.' Subtext: 'Ditch spreadsheets and WhatsApp. Manage patients, diagnostic testing, hearing-aid sales, and GST billing in one DPDPA-compliant platform.' Primary CTA Saffron button. Right side: Asymmetric overlapping cards showing a GST invoice, an audiogram snapshot, and calendar sync.
variant_A_outcome_focus.best_for: Fast comprehension and high B2B conversion.

variant_B_interactive_tech.layout: Center-aligned wide hero. H1: 'Run your audiology clinic like a modern hospital.' Massive center CTA. Below the fold: A massive 2.5D perspective mockup of the Diagnostics panel (Tympanogram / Audiogram illustration) hovering above a warm bone background.
variant_B_interactive_tech.best_for: Showing off technical depth and UI beauty.

variant_C_trust_proof.layout: 50/50 split. Left: High-quality image of an Indian doctor looking confident (overlay with floating UI widgets like 'GST Billed: ₹45,000'). Right: Bold typography, clear value prop, and CTA.
variant_C_trust_proof.best_for: Humanizing the brand and instantly building trust.

3_live_proof_banner.layout: Full-width slim ticker or centered badge block just below hero. Uses IBM Plex Mono. 'LIVE: 1,245 clinics ran 8,430 hearing tests today.'
3_live_proof_banner.style: Subtle pulsing green dot (Trust Emerald) next to 'LIVE'.

items: Col-span-8 Row-span-2: Patient Front-Desk & WhatsApp Sync (Large UI graphic).
Col-span-4 Row-span-1: GST-Ready Billing (Focus on the Indian context).
Col-span-full md:col-span-12 Row-span-1: 13-State Repair Workflow (Horizontal map/timeline tracker).

5_diagnostics_deep_dive.layout: Dark inverted section (Dark Mode palette) to simulate a clinical dark-room. Left: Deep-dive text on PTA / Tympanometry / OAE / ABR. Right: Large visual container reusing existing `AudiogramIllustration` and `TympanogramIllustration` components, styled with glowing data lines against deep indigo.
5_diagnostics_deep_dive.notes: Creates a pacing break in the page scrolling.

6_comparison_spreadsheets.layout: Two-column brutalist comparison table. Left Column (Spreadsheets + WhatsApp): Messy, red cross marks, jagged borders. Right Column (AUDINEXA): Clean, aligned, emerald checkmarks, smooth UI.
6_comparison_spreadsheets.concept: Visualizing the exact pain point of Indian clinic owners.

7_trust_founder_testimonials.layout: Carousel or Masonry grid of quotes from ENT-owned clinics. Accompanied by a 'Founder Letter' block: single photo of the medical founder, serif signature, explaining why this was built for India.

8_pricing.key_feature: A massive banner bridging the top of all cards: 'Everything is Premium for the first 30 days. No credit card required.'
8_pricing.style: Premium card uses the 'Tracing Beam' edge effect. CTAs are 'Start free trial'.

9_faq_and_footer.layout: FAQ: Accordion style (shadcn), left-aligned questions (Cabinet Grotesk) and answers (IBM Plex Sans). Footer: Massive 'Let's Talk' CTA at text-[8vw], standard multi-column links.

motion_notes.page_load: Hero text elements slide up with 0.1s stagger. Hero image/UI cards fade in with a slight scale-up (0.95 to 1.0).
motion_notes.scroll: Bento grid items fade up on scroll (Framer Motion `whileInView`).
motion_notes.micro_interactions: Buttons: scale down on click (scale: 0.98). Cards: subtle 1px border color shift on hover (border-border/40 to border-primary/50). Live proof ticker: gentle endless marquee or heartbeat pulse on the 'Live' indicator.

images.description: Indian doctor in clinic setting, looking confident.
Abstract audio/sound wave, colorful, dark background.

media_asset_plan.optimization: Use WebP format, lazy load all images below the fold.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or generic fonts for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Follow the 'Clinical Bone & Indian Saffron' color palette strictly. Avoid generic SaaS blue or heavy gradients.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Build the Bento grid using raw HTML/Tailwind classes (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) for layout, DO NOT force generic Shadcn cards into complex layouts.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The hero CTA MUST be 'Start free 30-day trial' linking to '/signup'. Remove all 'waitlist' terminology.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Incorporate the existing `AudiogramIllustration` and `TympanogramIllustration` components in the Diagnostics section.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements, e.g., `data-testid='hero-start-trial-button'`.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (using solid colors + sharp borders).
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, focus states, scale on click.
Use Generous Spacing Philosophy: p-8, p-12, p-16 to avoid cramped UI.
Ensure hover state contrast is accessible and visible.
For .js files, use standard React JS syntax, not TypeScript/TSX.
